scope: repository-wide documentation/governance consolidation; no Phase I implementation

lifecycle_classes.CURRENT: describes current product/runtime/navigation and must track current authority
lifecycle_classes.FROZEN_CONTRACT: accepted protected contract/gate authority; do not rewrite after later promotion
lifecycle_classes.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: accurate earlier milestone state; old current-state prose is not a defect when clearly historical
lifecycle_classes.ARCHIVE: superseded planning/navigation material retained for history

root_governance.HANDOFF.md: current operational stopping point and evidence pointers

principal_findings.finding: Roadmap V3.2 existed in project materials but not in the GitHub repository; old Post-M8C roadmap remained the apparent roadmap authority.
principal_findings.action: Created root ROADMAP.md from the complete Roadmap V3.2 source and made docs/roadmap/README.md point to it.

principal_findings.finding: Root AGENTS.md described a high-freedom source-discovery project rather than the governed Unified product.
principal_findings.action: Replaced AGENTS.md with current governance/authority/execution rules.

principal_findings.finding: Root README and Chinese README still described Request/Result/Audit V2 as current preferred authority after H-ACT-V3.
principal_findings.action: Realigned both front-door READMEs to V3 preferred with V1/V2 compatibility.

principal_findings.finding: Current operator/reference/architecture entry points still described the M5/M6 M5F/M5K/M5N product model.
principal_findings.action: Rebuilt the directly navigated current Quick Start, Workbench, Mode A/B/C, troubleshooting, MCP, API, capability, source, output, governance, architecture and data-flow pages. Older milestone-specific pages remain historical.

principal_findings.finding: Capability Catalog V3 retained stale capability-level wording that V2 was preferred and corporate-action V3 was only a candidate.
principal_findings.action: Corrected current Catalog metadata without changing route activation/executor truth, then regenerated portable catalog/guide.

principal_findings.finding: docs/INDEX.md mixed current product navigation with a large engineering-history list, encouraging agents to reconstruct current state from historical material.
principal_findings.action: Rebuilt index around root governance and current product docs; historical-heavy directories are explicitly classified.

principal_findings.finding: Several Post-M8C/M4 roadmap and remediation documents were obsolete as current planning surfaces.
principal_findings.action: Moved safe-to-relocate planning files to docs/archive/roadmap/.

principal_findings.finding: Two old roadmap/migration files cannot be safely relocated because tests or accepted historical evidence reference exact paths.
principal_findings.action: Kept exact paths but removed them from current navigation and classified them explicitly in docs/roadmap/README.md.

principal_findings.finding: V1_RELEASE.md contained 'Phase G has not started', which is stale as current state but correct release-time provenance.
principal_findings.action: Reframed the page as a historical immutable v1.0.0 release snapshot rather than rewriting release-time facts.

compatibility_preserved_historical_paths.reason: unit test and accepted historical closure artifacts reference the exact path; current navigation now classifies it as historical
unit test reads the exact path; retained as historical migration evidence

preserve_original_content: accepted freeze manifests and ledgers under docs/governance/
historical_areas_policy.rationale: These areas contain time-specific acceptance and audit evidence. Later current-state changes do not invalidate historically accurate statements.

roadmap_reconciliation.phase_g: accepted G1/G2 implementation exists, but whole Roadmap V3.2 Phase G is not declared complete
roadmap_reconciliation.phase_h: H-ACT-V3 and one H1 route are accepted, but whole Roadmap V3.2 Phase H is not declared complete

prohibited_cleanup_patterns: global replacement of V2-preferred historical statements
rewriting accepted acceptance ledgers to current V3 wording
deleting reviews/protocols merely because they are old
moving files whose exact paths are protected by tests/accepted evidence without a compatibility plan
next_gate: documentation/governance validation and merge closure; Phase I remains out of scope
